data.name: Danian
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Danian is derived from the name Dan, which means 'God is my judge'. This name was borne by several individuals in the Old Testament, including Dan, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and King Rehoboam’s advisor, Shemaiah the Danite. In Christianity, Danian can be seen as a reminder of God’s ultimate judgement over us.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God’s judgement and justice.
data.numerology_meaning: A powerful and ambitious soul, born to make a lasting impact on the world

in_hebrew.name: דניאן
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות השם 'דניאן' יכולה להתייחס לאדם שנושא חכמה ובונה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם 'דניאן' נזכר במקורות כיווניים ויהודיים, ומשמעותו יכולה להיות 'אדם חכם' או 'אדם שנושא חכמה'. שם זה הוא הלחם של גכ (דן) ו-הֱינ (יאן) - 'דן' שקולו 'חכמה' ו'יאן' שקולו 'אדם'. שם זה נמצא בכתבי יוסף בן מתתיהו, 'מלחמת היהודים' ו'אנטיקוטיס יודאיקה', שם הוא מבואר כ'אדם חכם' המביע דעה בענייני דת. שם 'דניאן' נמצא גם בספר 'באר היטב' - חואש ארא, שם הוא מבואר כ'אדם תמים' - אווא רארי.

in_latin.name: Danianus
in_latin.meaning: nomen Danianus potest significare hominem sapientem et facientem
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Danianus oriundum est a Danio et Iano, ubi Danio significat sapientiam et Iano hominem. Nomen huius generis in fontibus Iosephi Flavii, 'Bellum Iudaeorum' et 'Antiquitates Iudaeae', in quo declaratur 'homo sapientissimus', qui sententiam de rebus sacris exprimit. Nomen 'Danianus' in libro 'Baruch' invenitur, ubi declaratur 'homo simplex' - homo simplex, qui Deum colit.

in_english.name: Danian
in_english.meaning: the name Danian can refer to a wise and constructive person who builds wisdom
in_english.long_meaning: the name Danian has its roots in the Hebrew name Dania, which means wisdom, and the suffix Ian, which means man. This name is mentioned in the works of Josephus Flavius, 'The Jewish War' and 'Antiquities of the Jews', where it is declared 'the wisest of men', who expresses an opinion on sacred matters. The name 'Danian' is also found in the book 'Baruch', where it is declared 'a simple man' - a man who worships God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Danian does not have a significant cultural impact outside of Hebrew origin and Christian context. However, within these contexts, Danian can be seen as a name that holds historical and biblical significance. In Israelite culture, Dan was a significant tribe and played an important role in the history of the Israelites. In Christian tradition, the name Danian can serve as a reminder of the biblical account of the name Dan and its association with God’s judgement.
data.spiritual_significance: Within Christianity, Danian can be seen as a powerful reminder of the spiritual truth that God is both our judge and our savior. The name Dan means 'God is my judge', and it acknowledges that ultimately, God holds the power of judgement over our lives. However, this judgement is tempered by God’s love and mercy. As Christians, we trust that God’s judgement will be just and fair, and that He will be merciful and gracious to us. Danian is a name that encourages us to seek God’s judgement in our lives, knowing that He is a loving and compassionate judge. It is a name that invites us to approach God with confidence and trust, knowing that He will always be with us and will guide us on our spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Daniel, an exile from Judah, was one of four young men who served in Nebuchadnezzar's court. He was known for his ability to interpret dreams and was given the name Belteshazzar by the Babylonians. However, when he chose to keep his Jewish identity, he was given the name Daniel by his companions. This was during the Babylonian exile in the 6th century BCE.
historical_references.context: Babylonian exile, serving in Nebuchadnezzar's court

historical_references.reference: Daniel is also known for his prophetic visions, including the famous 'Seven Seals' vision in the book of Revelation. Some scholars believe that the 'Lamb with seven horns and seven eyes' described in this vision may have been influenced by the ancient Greek god Pan, who was also depicted with these attributes. This was during the Persian Empire in the 6th or 5th century BCE.
historical_references.context: Prophetic visions, influenced by ancient Greek god Pan during Persian Empire
